# OpenSAM

Private assisted research pilot from AliceLabs. Title search of first25 notices posted in last30days; active records from that page are displayed. Transparent title/NAICS matching supports human review. No automated bidding, eligibility determination or award probability.

Pilot scope, price, cadence and delivery are agreed in writing. No self-service plans, free trial, payment checkout, alerts, SSO or SLA are offered by the current web application.

Provider key is server-side. Authorized private pilot access required. Repository packages and apps have separate licenses; consult their files.

Contact: contact@alicelabs.site
Source: https://github.com/eddyflores100-lang/OpenSAM
Not affiliated with the U.S. Government, GSA or SAM.gov.
